mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_history (user_id, role, content, emotion, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{emotion}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, role, content, emotion, create_time FROM ai_chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
